items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Everybody was trying to play like Earl Hines, you know, and Teddy Wilson.

ctx.x: I misunderstood. I'd thought he joined that band in '32, but he says '33.
He wasn't with us then. I think Les was in Minneapolis at that time, in '32, playing with Hines, a piano player named Hines -- Frank Hines.
